3.source: Guards its village and attacks hostile mobs; does not trade
3.translation: Guarda sua vila e ataca inimigos hostis; não negocia

7.source: '''Namekian Warriors''' are the defenders of the Namekian villages on [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Planet Namek]]. They don't trade: they guard their village, fly, and fight the hostile mobs that come near.
7.translation: Os '''Guerreiros Namekuseijins''' são os defensores das vilas namekuseijins do [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|planeta Namekusei]]. Eles não negociam: guardam sua vila, voam e lutam contra os inimigos hostis que se aproximam.

9.source: Namekian Warriors are placed in the Namekian villages, Ajissa-style in the Ajissa Plains and Sacred-style in the Sacred Land, and the villages keep spawning a few more inside their walls.
9.translation: Os Guerreiros Namekuseijins são colocados nas vilas namekuseijins, no estilo Ajissa nas Planícies Ajissa e no estilo Sagrado na Terra Sagrada, e as vilas continuam gerando mais alguns dentro de suas muralhas.

11.source: Warriors use the village alert and defend behavior: they attack hostile mobs with about 15 melee damage and have 200 health. They can fly, and they return to their village when they wander off.
11.translation: Os guerreiros usam o comportamento de alerta e defesa da vila: atacam inimigos hostis com cerca de 15 de dano corpo a corpo e têm 200 de vida. Eles podem voar e voltam para a vila quando se afastam.

12.source: They are the main target of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Gete Robot|Gete Robots]] that march on the villages.
12.translation: São o alvo principal dos [[Special:MyLanguage/Gete Robot|Robôs Gete]] que marcham sobre as vilas.
